description: Source projection diagnostics contract: classifies source-projection-blocked lanes into missing_manifest, payload_dropped, budget_truncated, and worker_reported_insufficient_source so finalizers can exclude lanes from substantive quorum with a precise reason.

missing_manifest.description: Broker payload lacked sourceBundle.files[], embeddedSourceEvidence, and sourceEvidence. The manifest was absent entirely.
missing_manifest.finalizerAction: Exclude from quorum. Check dispatch payload — did the broker omit sourceBundle.files[]?
missing_manifest.troubleshooting: Inspect error.details.stdout and broker dispatch manifest. Verify sourceBundle was included in the task payload.

payload_dropped.description: Manifest had files[] but the bridge could not project any of them (empty content, unsafe paths, budget exhausted before any file was loaded).
payload_dropped.finalizerAction: Exclude from quorum. The manifest existed but no usable source reached the model.
payload_dropped.troubleshooting: Review droppedFiles[] in diagnostics for per-file reasons. Check maxFileBytes/maxTotalBytes limits.

budget_truncated.description: One or more source files were loaded but truncated by maxFileBytes or maxTotalBytes limits, or the overall prompt was truncated before invoking Hermes.
budget_truncated.finalizerAction: Evaluate whether truncated content was still sufficient. If yes, include in quorum; if no, exclude and note truncation.
budget_truncated.troubleshooting: Check truncatedFiles[] for per-file original vs kept byte counts. Verify totalSourceBytesRequested vs totalSourceBytesProjected.

worker_reported_insufficient_source.description: Worker model received source files but classified them as insufficient for substantive analysis.
worker_reported_insufficient_source.finalizerAction: Exclude from quorum. Worker explicitly reported source insufficiency.
worker_reported_insufficient_source.troubleshooting: Read worker analysis summary for missing evidence details. Consider supplement task with compact sourceBundle.

manifestPresent.description: Whether the payload included sourceBundle.files[], embeddedSourceEvidence, or sourceEvidence

manifestFileCount.description: Number of files in the manifest before projection

projectedFileCount.description: Number of files that made it into the model prompt

droppedFiles.description: Files in the manifest that could not be projected, with reasons

truncatedFiles.description: Files that were projected but truncated, with original/kept byte counts

budgetExhausted.description: Whether the prompt budget or file/total byte limits were hit

totalSourceBytesRequested.description: Total bytes of all source content before truncation

totalSourceBytesProjected.description: Total bytes that made it into the prompt

projectionClass.description: Classification of the source projection result

droppedFiles.reason: skipped empty embedded source file: embedded:packages/empty.ts

truncatedFiles.reason: content truncated by maxFileBytes or maxTotalBytes budget

workerOutput.summary: source evidence insufficient for analysis of #74
risks: missing #75 test evidence makes #74 evaluation impossible
recommendations: supplement with compact sourceBundle including test files

truncatedFiles.reason: content truncated by maxFileBytes or maxTotalBytes budget

assertions: sourceProjectionDiagnostics is attached to blocked and non-clean analysis responses
manifestPresent distinguishes missing manifest from payload dropped
droppedFiles[] lists every manifest file that failed projection with a reason
truncatedFiles[] lists every projected file that was truncated with original vs kept bytes
projectionClass is one of clean, missing_manifest, payload_dropped, budget_truncated, worker_reported_insufficient_source
budgetExhausted is true when any budget limit was hit
totalSourceBytesRequested and totalSourceBytesProjected allow finalizers to estimate truncation loss
finalizers can exclude missing_manifest and payload_dropped lanes automatically without manual JSON spelunking
